title: Blueprint task catalog
description: Output of `mise dev:catalog:json` (scripts/python/catalog_json.py). This is the contract a UI/plugin consumes. Additive changes keep schema_version; any breaking change bumps it.

name.description: The public task name; the stable CLI API. Pass to `mise run`.

args.description: Positional parameters, flattened from mise's usage_spec. Populated only for tasks that declare a `#USAGE arg` line (scripts) or a `usage` property (inline run). Render these as form inputs.

mise.description: The raw `mise tasks ls --json` object for this task, passed through unmodified. Note that mise omits `confirm` here; use execution.needs_confirmation instead.

execution.description: Everything a launcher needs to invoke the task correctly.

command.description: Base argv. Append declared args in order.

needs_tty.description: true means the task takes over the terminal (raw/interactive). Launch it in a terminal emulator; do not capture stdout.

needs_confirmation.description: true means the task carries a native `confirm`. Without a TTY mise aborts with "requires confirmation but there was nobody to ask", so a UI must show its own prompt and then append confirm_bypass_flag.

confirm_bypass_flag.description: The flag to append after the UI has obtained consent ("--yes"), or null when the task needs no confirmation. Never pass this without asking the user first.

cwd_scope.description: "caller": run with cwd set to a directory the user chooses. "project": run from the config root.
